notes: 9.27: a correction to the 9.26 export fix found by its review the same day - a clip whose frame rate differs from the project's could come out one frame short when cut mid-clip, and a phone recording with a dropped frame one frame long, stopping the export. Every clip's picture is now laid on the project's frame grid from the piece's start before its frames are counted. Install before exporting; an export that stopped continues from its finished segments. Includes 9.10-9.26.
